verdict.rationale: A probe found a live llms.txt at developer.nvidia.com that describes NVIDIA's developer portal, including the CUDA toolkit that runs on this GPU, so an agent can be pointed at NVIDIA's documentation. However, it is portal-wide rather than specific to the RTX 5070 Ti, and the markdown doc variant (cuda-toolkit.md) returns 404. missing for 10: GPU/GeForce-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, markdown versions of doc pages, and hands-on corroboration that agents can use the llms.txt effectively.
